subject.title: fix(agents): keep declared-output tools visible in the truncated code mode index

question: Should the truncated Code Mode quick index deliberately prioritize declared-output contracts over the prior alphabetical ordering when not every locally available tool fits?
rationale: Both orderings are deterministic, but the selected ordering defines which model-facing tool information is sacrificed under prompt truncation; this is an agents prompt-policy choice rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Adopt contract-first ordering
options.body: Accept the proposed deterministic grouping after real gateway evidence confirms that retained contracts improve the intended Code Mode workflow without impairing tool discovery.

options.title: Keep alphabetical ordering
options.body: Retain equal alphabetical visibility if maintainers consider stable neutral ordering more important than preserving output contracts under truncation.

options.title: Use a different bounded index policy
options.body: Request a separately specified policy, such as a compact contract-only section plus alphabetical discovery entries, if neither ordering represents the desired prompt behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt contract-first ordering
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed deterministic grouping after real gateway evidence confirms that retained contracts improve the intended Code Mode workflow without impairing tool discovery.
